$comment: Differences parity-compare.mjs accepts between a base dump and a head dump. Each entry: path (glob over the difference path; * stays within a segment, ** crosses them), optional kind (value | missing | extra), optional relative or absolute bound (then only numeric value differences inside it match), reason, ticket. A child PR adds the entries its decision accepts, nothing broader.

Vault APYs are live: a vault accrues between two dumps taken seconds apart (seen 4e-13 on World Chain Re7 USDC, read through unchanged GraphQL code)

Point counts: the 1M/3M series is Core's ninety_days lookback (94 daily rows); the GraphQL fetch added a 10-day margin (101 rows)
